name: generate_music
description: Generate a music clip from a text prompt via Gemini Lyria 3 Clip or ElevenLabs. Generation step — produces a file on disk; composition happens at render time.

output.description: Path to the generated music clip (plus duration metadata when --json)

params.name: prompt
params.description: Text description of the music (genre, mood, instrumentation, BPM)

params.name: out
params.description: Output audio file path. The extension is advisory — the file is named after the container the vendor actually returns (mp3 in practice), never re-encoded to match. Read the emitted path rather than assuming this one.

params.name: vendor
params.description: Music vendor to use. ElevenLabs music needs their paid plan.

params.name: model
params.description: Override the vendor's default model (Gemini default: lyria-3.5, ~30s clips)

params.name: seed
params.description: RNG seed for reproducible outputs. Gemini only; ignored for ElevenLabs.

params.name: with-vocals
params.description: Allow vocals in the output. Gemini only; ElevenLabs ignores this. Omit (default) for instrumental-only — recommended for background music under narration.

params.name: duration
params.description: Clip length in seconds. Required for --vendor elevenlabs (minimum 3s); ignored for Gemini, whose Lyria model produces a fixed-length clip.
